{{Quote|No doubt you've been busy with religious retreats? Mercantile conferences? Milk deliveries for the Interstellar Children's Aid Fund?|Jessa Vandangante|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
The '''Interstellar Children's Aid Fund''' was a goodwill organization that operated throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to aid children in need. Much of their workforce was voluntary, handling the pickup and delivery of the donations.
